Absolute https URL with matching text renders as autolink (#397)

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<a href=\"https://example.com\">https://example.com</a>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
